asked: I’d like you to do another 20 weak meld checks
picked: I took the next 20 smallest by my measure, none of them worked on before.
checks: The game's rules check on the 20: 0 wrong. Each in front of the Strike and behind it, 40 cases, its twist seen in all 40.
All 20 filmed again: no script errors; each one's own moment on a monster seen in all 20.
Your hero kept in sight (Animations 4): nothing covers him for a run of frames in any of the 20; at most a quarter of him for a blink as a blow lands, as before.

why: Its slam on each blow never played: the game never told the painter it happened.
Behind, its ground tearing open at a full frenzy never showed in the film.
done: Each blow now comes down with slabs of floor heaving up round it, grit thrown out along a front and cracks torn out from it, a screen kick that grows with the frenzy, and a freeze.
At a full frenzy the ground tears open twice as wide.
On a monster, the floor heaves under you in slabs as it knocks you back.

why: Its needles were thin and short.
Behind, the mark it leaves on the staggered one never played: the game never told the painter.
done: Six long white needles close in from all round, then a star of light where they meet, with a freeze.
Behind, the needles stay standing in the staggered one, pulsing, with a cross of light on the floor under it.

why: Behind, nothing of its own showed: its splash as the frenzy builds was never told to the painter.
done: Its splash now plays: grit kicked out along a front, bigger the fuller the frenzy, a second front hard behind it at a full frenzy, stones and a screen kick.
In front, its swell grows a second front with the frenzy too.

why: It drew nothing of its own: the arc it rides is drawn as Lightning's own, and the life it wins had no look.
done: Where its arc strikes, an amber flash with small bolts leaping off it and bits of the life it wins.
On a monster, that flash is at the monster it heals, not on you.

why: It drew little of its own: a faint glow on the stunned one.
done: The stunned one's bone-white glow cracks open, three pulses going out, stones kicked up and a screen kick.
As it drains, a bone-white flare and splinters of light rising.
On a monster, bone-white swells on it and a ring of splinters closes in.

why: Its guard on the floor was a plain ring (How art is made 9).
done: Its guard is now a ring of parrying blades standing on its edge, flashing one after another as it forms, a sound front going out.

why: Its ghost looked like a grey box.
On a monster, a wailing mouth was drawn over you.
done: A proper ghost: a hood rounding into shoulders, lit from one side, its torn hem in three swaying strands, eyes burning in a dark face.
On a monster the ghost follows at your shoulder, its wail going out at you, not over you.

why: Its shade was the same grey box, and it passed across you as it circled.
On a risen monster, nothing circled it.
done: The same ghost, with a small shield face, circling above your head, never across you.
On a risen monster it circles the monster where it stands.

why: Its heartbeat over you was small and a dull brown, and nothing went out from what you struck.
done: A pink heartbeat over your head, twice the size, beating twice as hard below half life, a pulse going out from what you struck.
Its life orbs streak in to you from all round.
On a monster, its heartbeat beats over the monster.

why: Its gust was a thin loop of wind, gone in a blink.
done: A wider gust of green wind whipping round you, curls of wind thrown off it and streaks all round, held a little longer. The same round a monster.

why: Its barbs were tiny.
On a monster they floated in the air beside you.
done: Bigger barbs, banded black like a hornet, dripping venom, and a barb jabbed in as a hit poisons.
On a monster they stand in the floor beside you.

why: Its smoke was small, and its ground biting was a faint flicker.
done: Smoke rolls out over the struck ground in big curls, embers glinting in it, a shock front under it.
Where something steps in, jagged teeth of grit snap up, shut and sink back, with stones and a screen kick.

why: Its two ticks were small and greyish.
On a monster they were drawn over you.
done: Two bigger ticks in its own pink with a white core, the second sharp on the first, sparks and a click of sound off each, and a screen kick.
On a monster they land beside you, not over you.

why: Its crack was a small flash.
done: A big white star with twelve rays, its sound lines thrown far, a hard screen kick and a freeze.

why: Its jaws showed only at a full frenzy of five.
done: Jaws snap shut on what you strike from the first step of the frenzy, bigger the fuller it is, with a screen kick.

why: Its crack and its glint were small.
done: A longer crack, four tiles, in three lines, with a star at its point and a glow. Its draw glints brighter.

why: Its sight finding the weakest was a small, short flash.
done: The sight closes on the weakest crackling, small bolts leaping off it, a white flash as it is found, held longer.

why: Its cut was a thin line.
done: A long, fine cut opens across it in its own colours, drops of red falling off its line.

why: On a monster, its pull on you had almost no look, and its swirl sat in the air over your feet.
done: Currents race from you to the monster as it drags you, a rip of water swirling on the floor under your feet, then streaks behind it as it rushes in.

why: On a monster, its pull on you had almost no look, and its swirl sat in the air over your feet.
done: A vortex turning on the floor at your feet, its arms reaching toward the monster, the pull streaming along them.

found: A gameplay fault, fixed at your word: with a barrier, Parry, Sanctuary, Aegis and Shieldwall did nothing at all, because Guarding tops up the barrier and they waited on a fresh shield. Now a top-up counts.
Seven other shields (Redoubt, Sanctuary, Aegis, Minefield, Riposte, Shieldwall, Carapace) still lay a plain ring on the floor under their marks. Not among these 20; left as they are.
correction: Mid-way I said Gravewarden, Quickdraw and Hornet covered your hero. The measure says none of the 20 did for more than a blink. What was really wrong: Gravewarden's shade passed across you, and Hornet's barbs floated off you on a monster. Both are fixed; Quickdraw needed nothing for this.
picked_how: The 20 smallest in ranking_pass2.json (../meld_rules_check2) not among the 30 weakest, the second pass's 12, or the 26 monster moments of 26 Nov.
